{{Top|leg}}
'''Lawn lice''' (s. '''lawn louse''') were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]]. They made a whimpering noise when disturbed. The native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the world, the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]], domesticated lawn lice to tend the magenta [[Grass/Legends|grass]] of the lawns around their homes. A well-tended lawn might host thousands of such insects.<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', Chapter 10.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' only uses the term ''lawn lice'' in the plural. As the English singular for ''lice'' is ''louse,'' this article uses that spelling.
